ModMetaData.name: Grutt Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces VanillaExpanded.VGeneticsE's GR_Molebear art and label/description (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: non-SW names are free to be reimagined (general kind fixed, specific name/character not). GR_Molebear is reimagined as **Grutt**, a tusked, armor-plated burrower with oversized digging claws and blind vestigial eyes - not a literal mole-bear. Full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
defName is NOT renamed (donor mod's def, not ours - see GritheArtOverride for the same reasoning). loose Textures/ at the same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Rodent/Molebear/GR_Molebear_<facing>) the donor uses, plus a small Patches/ pass renaming the label/description on both the ThingDef and the PawnKindDef.
